about: win-pct-3 evaluation function, label 'power' (tribe holds the most cities at t+H; ties: strongest military, then in-game score). Fitted by tools/winpct_fit.py write on 14 games (all but ed6cb932); calibration = leave-one-game-out out-of-fold predictions. Conditional logit over the tribes alive at t: P = softmax(((x - mu)/sd) . w).
label: power
